clue.text: Cartel work with City

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a musical work
EC is the postal district of the City of London, the financial centre

explanation.surface: A price-fixing ring teams up with the bankers of the City of London.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is the square mile of London's financial district, postcode EC.
explanation.definitionFit: The oil exporters' organisation is the best-known example of a producers' cartel.

clue.text: Detecting scent, see, rising over plant

indicators.note: over, in a down clue, means this piece sits above the next
rising, in a down clue, means the letters read upwards

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning see! or behold!
a plant is an industrial works or factory

explanation.surface: A gardener smells something and notices a plant growing tall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks botanical; it is an industrial plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Olfactory means relating to the sense of smell.

clue.text: Scandalous bet incriminates member of government

indicators.note: scandalous means outrageous or improper, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A disgraceful wager brings down a senior politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabinet minister is a senior politician sitting in the government's cabinet.

clue.text: Former president with influence means to get round America

parts.note: ex- means former, as in ex-wife
to have sway is to have influence or power

explanation.surface: An ex-president still pulling strings works out how to tour the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: An expressway is a fast American highway, a way of travelling around the country by road.

clue.text: Stretcher case I left superficially injured

indicators.note: injured means damaged, so the letters are mangled into a new order
superficially means only at the surface, so just the outside letters of left are used

explanation.surface: A hospital patient on a stretcher was left with only minor injuries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stretcher case' reads as one phrase, but the definition is just 'Stretcher'; 'superficially' gives LT, the outer letters of 'left'.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastic is a material that stretches, so it is literally a stretcher.

clue.text: Fool blocking servant's way through

indicators.note: blocking means sitting in the middle of, so the fool lies within the servant

parts.note: a page is a young servant or attendant
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A foolish person stands in a servant's corridor, blocking the way.
explanation.definitionFit: A passage is a corridor or route through which one can pass.

clue.text: Trade sanction so engrossing business graduate

indicators.note: engrossing means absorbing, so the Latin word swallows the graduate

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore, so
an MBA is a Master of Business Administration

explanation.surface: A trade restriction is so absorbing for a business student.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official ban on trade with a particular country.

clue.text: Impending threat that could make some old cowards start to flee

indicators.note: could make means the letters might be formed into something new, rearranged
start to means the opening letter of flee is taken

explanation.surface: A looming danger might send a few elderly cowards running.
explanation.walkthrough: The legendary courtier Damocles sat beneath a sword hung by a single hair.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes an ever-present danger hanging over someone, ready to fall.

clue.text: Surrender return on investment

definitions.meaning: the income or interest an investment produces

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to give in and the profit or income produced by money invested.

clue.text: Keeps in check worries about planet?

indicators.note: about means going round, so the worries wrap around the planet

parts.note: fears are worries; to fear is to worry
an orb is a sphere, poetically a heavenly body such as a planet

explanation.surface: Someone restrains themselves despite anxieties about the state of the world.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that a planet is only loosely an orb.
explanation.definitionFit: To forbear is to hold back or refrain, restraining oneself from acting.

clue.text: Brazil's first and second then French XI in third place

indicators.note: first and second ask for the opening two letters of the country's name

parts.note: onze is French for eleven, written XI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A football report: Brazil lead, then a French eleven, finishing third.
explanation.definitionFit: A bronze medal goes to whoever finishes third, so the metal stands for that position.

clue.text: Wind instrument — blow me having score to follow

indicators.note: to follow means the scoring piece comes after the exclamation

parts.note: cor! is a British exclamation of surprise, like blow me!
to net is to score a goal

explanation.surface: A brass player is told to blow, with the musical score coming next.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blow' and 'score' sound musical but are an exclamation and a goal; COR is everyday British slang for 'gosh'.
explanation.definitionFit: A cornet is a small brass instrument, played by blowing, like a short trumpet.

clue.text: Clipped dunce's head with a spanner first

indicators.note: first says the a-spanner piece is placed before the dunce's head

parts.note: a bridge spans a gap, so it is a spanner

indicators.note: head means the first letter of the word dunce

explanation.surface: A dunce gets a clip round the head from someone wielding a spanner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spanner' wants to be a tool; it is something that spans, a bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: An abridged text has been cut down, its length clipped short.

clue.text: European working a very long time

parts.note: on means working, as a machine that is switched on

explanation.surface: A European has been at work for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: An eon is an immensely long period, an age without end.

clue.text: Block and close tab that's dodgy

indicators.note: dodgy means suspect or unsound, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone at a bar blocks a suspicious bill and shuts the tab.
explanation.definitionFit: A block is a barrier or impediment, something standing in the way.

clue.text: Scientist heading away to have good time fairly soon

indicators.note: to have says the shortened scientist takes on the extra letter
heading away means the first letter goes

parts.note: a boffin is British slang for a scientist or technical expert

explanation.surface: A scientist sneaks off to enjoy themselves for a while soon.
explanation.walkthrough: BOFFIN is British slang for a scientist. 'Good time' looks like fun; 'time' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in the offing is coming in the near future, the offing being that period.

clue.text: Stay a week held in irons? That will do for conspirator

parts.note: a guy is a rope that stays or steadies a tent or mast

indicators.note: held in means kept inside, so the irons enclose the short week

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron, so irons gives Fes

explanation.surface: A prisoner held in shackles for a week suits a plotter fine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That will do for' links wordplay to definition. GUY FAWKES led the 1605 Gunpowder Plot against Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: He was one of the Catholic plotters who tried to blow up the House of Lords.

clue.text: Yankee airborne flying erratically

parts.note: Yankee is Y in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a-wing is an old word meaning on the wing, in flight

explanation.surface: An American aircraft in flight wobbles off course.
explanation.definitionFit: Yawing is an aircraft swinging side to side about its vertical axis, an unsteady motion.

clue.text: What's left from burning tree

definitions.meaning: the powdery residue after a fire
a common deciduous tree with winged seeds, genus Fraxinus

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the residue of a fire and a familiar tree.

clue.text: Support for driver in popular car by junction, reportedly?

parts.note: the Volkswagen Golf is a popular car

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so the letter is replaced by a word of the same sound

parts.note: a T-junction is one road meeting another, shaped like the letter T

explanation.surface: A motorist parks a popular hatchback by a road junction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Driver' looks like a motorist; it is a golf club.
explanation.definitionFit: A tee is the peg that holds up the ball for a golfer's driver.

clue.text: Settled a claim by not fighting?

definitions.note: adverbial sense: in a peaceful way, without a fight

indicators.note: settled means resolved or rearranged, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A legal claim was resolved out of court without a battle.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting amicably means being friendly and peaceable, the opposite of quarrelling.

clue.text: Monk who is leader in artificial intelligence arguing from first principles

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the monk goes within the two letters

parts.note: a prior is a monk who heads a priory

explanation.surface: A monastic head is at the forefront of AI research.
explanation.definitionFit: A priori reasoning proceeds from known premises or theory rather than experience.

clue.text: Variety of salad vegetable — only its tip's usually taken in

definitions.meaning: a crisp, pale kind of lettuce

definitions.text: only its tip's usually taken in
definitions.meaning: of a floating mass of ice, only the top is seen; taken in means noticed

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a crunchy lettuce and the floating ice mass whose bulk lies hidden underwater.

clue.text: Agriculturalist engages personnel department for exciting work

indicators.note: engages means holds or takes in, so the farmer surrounds the department

parts.note: a tiller is one who tills the soil, a farmer
HR, human resources, is the personnel department

explanation.surface: A farmer hires the personnel office for some stimulating employment.
explanation.definitionFit: A thriller is a suspenseful novel or film, a gripping piece of entertainment.

clue.text: Snacks from recycling pasta

indicators.note: recycling means processing again into a new form, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Bar nibbles made from leftover noodles.
explanation.definitionFit: Tapas are small Spanish savoury dishes served with drinks.

clue.text: Heather getting to grips with old Beethoven piece

indicators.note: getting to grips with means clasping, so the heather holds the letter

parts.note: erica is the botanical genus of heather

explanation.surface: A woman called Heather tackles a classic Beethoven work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name; it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Beethoven's Third Symphony is known by this Italian title meaning heroic.

clue.text: Getting over the hill, some sherpas titter

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Mountain guides snigger as climbers labour over a summit.
explanation.definitionFit: Being over the hill is an idiom for being too old, which is how someone getting old is described.

clue.text: Disregard finished appearance

parts.note: over means finished, ended
a look is a person's appearance

explanation.surface: Ignore the polished look of something completed.
explanation.definitionFit: To overlook something is to fail to notice it or deliberately ignore it.

clue.text: Cutting down fat

definitions.meaning: making something briefer, reducing its length
the solid fat, such as lard, used in baking pastry

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both making shorter and the butter or lard rubbed into pastry.

clue.text: Health resorts getting gullible people to return

indicators.note: to return means go back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: saps are easily fooled people

explanation.surface: Wellness retreats attract the same naive customers coming back.
explanation.definitionFit: Spas are resorts with mineral springs or treatments offered for wellbeing.
